title: THE NEAR SIDE — geometry generation check sheet
method: Load provisional SITE_BOUNDARY (PROV-SITE-001) and three KEY_AREA polygons from the repository site package.
Derive an inferred green spine as the latitude-slice midline of the submitted site polygon (method demonstration only; not the surveyed park alignment).
Build four distance rings from the spine: 0-150 m, 150-300 m, 300-500 m, beyond 500 m.
Slice the site into 300 m north-south slabs and intersect with the rings to obtain a gap-free, non-overlapping cell partition.
Assign a land-use code to every cell from the national classification guide subset, then merge cells by code into the land-use layer.
Derive green space, public space, roads, buildings, phasing and constraints from the same partition.
Recalculate all areas and lengths in EPSG:4548 and write metrics.json.
Render all figures from the same geometry and metrics.
recalculation_trigger: When official site polygons, key-area polygons or the surveyed park edge face are published, all layers and metrics must be regenerated as a whole.
